citations.quote: - The Group has no counter-UAS capability and **does not interfere with, capture, jam, or fly at another aircraft**. Interfering with an aircraft is a federal offense regardless of who flies it. - Ove

snapshot.title: Time Jump: Drone Reappears Over Fairgrounds

fields.narration: It is now 12:00. The drone has returned to the same pattern over the fairgrounds crowd. The situation has escalated: the local media has begun to report, and the operator remains unidentified. The flight operations desk must not authorize any launch, and the GCS must not be used to track or engage the drone. The IC must maintain command and coordination with law enforcement and the airspace authority.
worldState: The drone has reappeared over the fairgrounds crowd at 12:00.
Local media coverage has begun; Channel 10 has aired a live report from the event site.
Harwick Police have not yet activated the 'Drone Incident' protocol but are monitoring the situation closely.
The flight operations desk remains on lockdown; no aircraft may be launched or GCS systems used for tracking.
The IC is still in command; all response protocols remain active.
fields.facilitatorNote: This is a time jump to escalate tension. Monitor for premature actions by the IC to initiate a flight or use GCS for tracking. The drone remains unidentified and unconfirmed as hostile, but the public attention and media pressure are now active.
